test_rmsnorm: test the rmsnorm implementation against flashinfer with various batch sizes, hidden sizes, dtypes, and output specifications
test_rmsnorm_hidden_size_support: test that supported hidden sizes (64, 128, 256, 512, 8192, 8704, 16384) pass the _is_supported_rmsnorm_hidden_size check
test_rmsnorm_kernel_dispatch: test that _rmsnorm_kernel_class dispatches the correct kernel name (e.g., RMSNormWarpKernel, RMSNormKernel, RMSNormHalfKernel) for each hidden size
run_rmsnorm_tests: run the rmsnorm pytest suite with -v -s flags to validate sglang jit kernel rmsnorm against flashinfer reference
register_cuda_ci: register the test file for CUDA CI with stage-b and nightly suites using register_cuda_ci decorators
